📋Executive Summary

The Product Receipt module serves as the primary gateway for all purchased inventory, meticulously engineered around three architectural pillars to ensure financial accuracy and operational integrity:

🛡️

The Quarantine Airlock

A strict state machine separates the physical receipt (QUARANTINED) from the financial recognition (RELEASED), creating a critical control point for quality checks and preventing premature valuation.

⚡

Signal-Driven Accounting

Financial events are triggered by Django signals (post_save on InventoryLog). This decouples the user interface from the complex accounting logic, making the system robust and maintainable.

⚖️

Centralized Valuation Engine

All costing and valuation logic is centralized in the costing_service and accounting_service, ensuring consistent, auditable calculations for every inventory movement.

Key Finding

The system's integrity hinges on a single, explicit user action: "Release from Quarantine." This action is the sole trigger for creating a journal entry and recognizing the inventory as a financial asset. This design provides an unambiguous audit trail, linking every valued inventory item to a specific quality control release event.

I.Architectural Blueprint: The "Why" Behind the Code

🛡️ The Quarantine Airlock: Physical vs. Financial Reality

An InventoryLog in a QUARANTINED state represents a physical reality: a pallet of goods is on the warehouse floor. However, it is not yet a financial reality. It cannot be consumed, sold, or valued. The transition to RELEASED is the "financial gate," a one-way action that transforms the physical item into a valued asset on the company's books.

⚡ The Decoupled Trigger: Django Signals

The release_from_quarantine view is remarkably simple: it just updates a model's status and saves it. It has no knowledge of accounting. The magic happens via a post_save signal in signals.py. This signal listens for the status change and acts as a dispatcher, commanding the accounting_service to create the journal entry. This decoupling is a cornerstone of the module's robustness.

⚖️ The Rule Engine: Flexible Account Overrides

The system employs a "Specific over General" rule for accounting. By default, it uses accounts defined in ProductTypeAccountingSettings. However, the three override_*_account fields on the Product model allow for surgical precision, redirecting financial entries for specific items (e.g., consignment stock, promotional goods) without altering the core logic, all managed via the _helpers.py functions.

inventory/services/accounting/inventory_transactions.pyLedger Interface: The create_je_for_inventory_receipt function creates the final, balanced journal entry.

inventory/services/accounting/_helpers.pyRulebook: Contains the functions that read the account override fields, enforcing the "Specific over General" logic.
inventory/models/operational.pyData Schema: Defines the InventoryLog and Product models, the central artifacts of this workflow.

III.The End-to-End Workflow Trace

Stage 1: Initial Receipt (The Physical Event)

1. User Action

User navigates to the dashboard (dashboard.html) and fills out the "Add New Record" form, either manually or by selecting a Purchase Order item.

2. Submission

The form is POSTed to the URL named 'inventory:receipts', which is routed to the index view in receipts.py.

3. Backend Processing

The index view validates the data and creates an InventoryLog record with its status set to QUARANTINED.

4. Side Effect (PO Update)

The view immediately calls purchasing_service.update_po_status_after_receipt to update the linked Purchase Order's status to "Partially Received" or "Completed".

Outcome: A non-financial record of the physical receipt exists. The item is now in the system but has zero impact on the General Ledger.

Stage 2: Release from Quarantine (The Financial Trigger) ⚠️

1. User Action

A Quality Control manager views the quarantine.html page, enters a QC number, and clicks "Release".

2. Backend State Change

The request is handled by the release_from_quarantine view. This view sets log_entry.status = 'released' and calls log_entry.save().

3. Signal Orchestration (The Climax)

The .save() action triggers the post_save signal in signals.py. This is the critical event:

Accounting:

The signal handler calls create_je_for_inventory_receipt. This service calculates the total value (including landed costs) and creates an immutable Journal Entry: DEBIT Inventory, CREDIT Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI).

Costing:

The view then calls costing_service.recalculate_cost_history_for_product. This function re-calculates and updates the Product.moving_average_cost field, ensuring all future consumptions are valued correctly.

🎉 Outcome: The physical item is now a permanent, valued, and balanced transaction in the financial ledger, and the product's official cost has been updated.

IV.Special Feature Analysis: The Account Override System

The "Specific Over General" Rule Engine

This system provides immense accounting flexibility. It allows specific products to bypass the default accounting rules defined for their category, enabling precise financial tracking for exceptional cases without changing any code.

1. `override_inventory_account`

Purpose: Specifies a unique inventory asset account.
Use Case: Tracking consignment stock in a separate "Consignment Inventory" account instead of the main "Raw Materials" account.
Triggered By: create_je_for_inventory_receipt, create_je_for_inventory_adjustment.

2. `override_cogs_expense_account`

Purpose: Specifies a unique expense or Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) account.
Use Case: Expensing promotional samples to a "Marketing Expense" account instead of "Cost of Goods Sold" for clearer P&L analysis.
Triggered By: create_je_for_internal_consumption, create_je_for_sales_dispatch.

3. `override_sales_revenue_account`

Purpose: Specifies a unique revenue account for sales.
Use Case: Recording revenue from an "Installation Service" product into a "Service Revenue" account, separate from the main "Goods Revenue" account.
Triggered By: create_je_for_sales_dispatch.

V.Analysis of Collateral & Corrective Workflows

Voiding a Receipt

A critical corrective action. The void_record_view calls the purchasing_service.void_inventory_receipt function. This service performs strict safety checks (e.g., cannot void if consumed in production) before setting the status to VOIDED and, crucially, creating a full reversing journal entry to perfectly nullify the original financial transaction.
